positions.subject: q:ai/data-center-moratorium
positions.summary: Opposes a blanket data center moratorium; favors local decisions and energy and water protections.

positions.subject: q:ai/frontier-ai-safety-disclosure
positions.summary: Authored California's SB 53, the frontier-AI transparency law enacted in 2025, and supports safety and transparency standards.

positions.subject: q:civil-rights/lgbtq-nondiscrimination
positions.summary: His campaign issues page says he will champion passage of the Equality Act, giving LGBTQ Americans legal protections in housing, employment and public accommodations.

citations.quote: Champion passage of the Equality Act, a federal civil rights law that finally gives LGBTQ Americans full legal protections in housing, employment, and public accommodations.

positions.subject: q:civil-rights/voting-rights-preclearance
positions.summary: His campaign issues page says he will fight to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act and restore the protections the Supreme Court removed.

citations.quote: He will fight to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act and restore the protections the Supreme Court stripped away.
Pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, restoring the protections that Republican-controlled courts and legislatures have spent years dismantling.
citations.locator: "In Congress, Scott will work to" list

positions.subject: q:healthcare/single-payer
positions.summary: Supports Medicare for All; also seeks reversing Medicaid cuts and stronger patient protections.

positions.subject: q:housing/transit-oriented-upzoning
positions.summary: Authored SB 79 (signed October 2025), which sets state zoning standards allowing midrise homes within a half mile of major transit stops; his campaign site lists it among his laws requiring cities to zone for more homes near public transportation.

citations.quote: The new law establishes state zoning standards around train stations and major bus stops to allow for midrise homes within a half mile of major transit stops, and allows local transit agencies to develop on land they own.
“SB 79 is a historic step toward tackling the root cause of California’s affordability crisis — our profound shortage of homes and too few people having access to transit,” said Senator Wiener.
They also require cities to zone for more homes, especially near public transportation;
citations.locator: Scott's Legislative Track Record (SB 35, SB 423, SB 828, SB 765, SB 312, SB 4, and SB 79)

positions.subject: q:immigration/abolish-ice
positions.summary: His campaign issues page lists "Abolish ICE" among his goals in Congress and says he has supported abolishing ICE since 2018.

citations.locator: "In Congress, Scott will work to" list

citations.quote: Since 2018, Scott has supported abolishing ICE, which is a broken agency.

positions.subject: q:immigration/expand-skilled-work-visas

citations.quote: We also must expand pathways to obtain a green card.

points.text: Supports expanding work visas (“Yes to both”).

citations.quote: Yes to both. People from around the world come here to work and make our country better and stronger. We need a stronger pathway for them to do so.

points.text: Calls for relief for the green-card backlog affecting applicants born in India and China (June primary questionnaire).
Calls for H-1B and O-1 visa processing reform (June primary questionnaire).
Calls green-card waits of years or decades a broken system that needs reform.

citations.quote: For so many people, they face wait times of years or decades to obtain a green card. That’s ridiculous, and we need to reform this broken system.

positions.summary: Supports expanding work visas and green cards; specifies H-1B/O-1 processing reform and relief for the green-card backlog affecting applicants born in India and China.

citations.quote: Yes to both. People from around the world come here to work and make our country better and stronger. We need a stronger pathway for them to do so.
We also must expand pathways to obtain a green card.

positions.subject: q:reproductive-rights/federal-abortion-protection
positions.summary: His campaign issues page says he will work to codify the right to abortion into federal law.

citations.quote: Codify the right to abortion into federal law, restoring and permanently protecting the core rights lost with the fall of Roe v. Wade.
citations.locator: "In Congress, Scott will work to" list

positions.subject: q:taxes/federal-wealth-tax
positions.summary: Supports Warren’s Ultramillionaire Tax: 2% on fortunes above $50 million and 3% above $1 billion.

positions.subject: q:technology/platform-self-preferencing
positions.summary: Authored SB 1074 (the BASED Act), a 2026 bill aimed at stopping big tech from unfairly boosting its own products.
